name: Omar Haddad
summary: Quality engineer working on software that generates customer-facing text. Four years developing repeatable assessments and helping product teams understand failure patterns.

work_experience.title: AI Quality Engineer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Built a versioned collection of customer requests with reviewer-written descriptions of acceptable responses.
Separated factual support, completeness, and writing quality in reviewer scorecards.
Compared automated model-based ratings with human decisions and investigated systematic disagreement.
Added difficult cases involving misleading source passages and questions for which no answer was available.
Blocked releases when previously passing customer scenarios regressed, even when the overall average improved.

work_experience.title: Quality Automation Engineer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Maintained Python checks for business services and assembled reproducible failure reports.
Worked with developers to isolate whether failures came from source data, generated text, or surrounding software.

projects.name: Answer review workbench
projects.description: Collected independent reviewer judgments, measured agreement, and retained an untouched sample for final comparison. Documented where automatic ratings were too forgiving of convincing but unsupported statements.
